7724.title: Panel selection tears down terminal client sessions
7724.rootCauseOneLine: Inactive panel selection unmounts the terminal client; recreating its zero-offset transport replays retained output.
7724.proposedFix: Retain terminal clients across tab and thread visibility changes, with explicit bounded lifetime and disposal policy.
7724.caveats: Panel lifecycle and live transport replay repeated by the same investigator in a second trusted checkout. Desktop scrolling, thread navigation, and timing were not visually driven because Chrome was unavailable. Repro sources are inline per reports repository policy. No safe simple fix was attempted because cross-thread client ownership and eviction need an architecture decision.
